import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t); e=np.exp(-v)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*v+params[3]*v*v+params[4]*e+params[5]*c+params[6]*s
            +params[7]*v*c+params[8]*v*s+params[9]*e*c)
